title: Import from Kindle
description: Bring in the My Clippings.txt file from your Kindle. New highlights are added to your library; ones you've imported before are skipped.

file.title: Your clippings file
file.hint: A plain text file from your Kindle's documents folder.
file.wrongType: That doesn't look like My Clippings.txt. Choose the .txt file from your Kindle.

visibility.title: Who can see these highlights
visibility.label: Visibility
visibility.publicDescription: Shown on your profile and in the Square.
visibility.privateDescription: Only you can see them. You can make single highlights public later.

done.duplicates_one: {{count}} highlight was already in your library.
done.duplicates_other: {{count}} highlights were already in your library.

errors.title: The import stopped
errors.read: We couldn't open this file. Check it's still on your device and try again.
errors.parse: We couldn't read this file. Only English and Chinese Kindle exports are supported.
errors.upload: Saving failed part-way. Highlights saved so far are kept; importing again will skip them.
errors.search: Some books couldn't be matched and were left for review.

help.title: Where is My Clippings.txt?
help.body: Connect your Kindle to a computer with a USB cable. Open the Kindle drive, go into the documents folder, and you'll find My Clippings.txt.

global.title: Import this file?
global.overlay: Drop to import your Kindle highlights
